title: Localize the hardcoded 'Curriculum settings' tooltip in curriculum_progress_screen.dart
why: Every other string on this screen goes through AppLocalizations (l10n.curriculumProgressBreakdownByLevel, l10n.errorUnknownCurriculum, etc.); this one literal renders in English regardless of device locale, so a Hebrew-locale, RTL user long-pressing the settings gear sees an English tooltip in an otherwise fully-Hebrew screen.
recommendation: Add an ARB key (EN+HE) and use l10n.<key> instead of the literal.
acceptance_criteria: make arb-parity stays green with the new key present in both app_en.arb and app_he.arb.
The tooltip: parameter on this IconButton references an l10n getter, not a string literal.
mergedFrom: Route the hardcoded 'Curriculum settings' tooltip through AppLocalizations in curriculum_progress_screen.dart
